method: Read full execution rules lines1-295, A37 table, expansion rules and name traps.
Read canonical QUEUE/CROSSWALK/R58-A/WORKFLOW/BASELINE/baseline fidelity snapshot and inspect actual active production code.
Reopened selected official pages and viewed eight actual images. No panorama or browser/game render was used.
No production model build, no broad tests, no canonical document writes, no git changes or publication.
globalFindings: All 37 source objects have empty canonical requiredChildIds; proposed child labels below must be adopted as typed relationships before aggregate closure. They are not new approved canonical IDs.

Five A-row fidelity records inherit prior implementation; gates/bridges without fidelity records still have meaningful dedicated code. inheritedProgressRetained:false must not be read as no prior work.

Several definite existing instances/groups require binding repair rather than new construction: Wuying bridge trio, half bridge, four-pavilion group children and five inner-bridge children; four side-room galleries and four outer-hall galleries have positional runtime candidates.
The A release includes 25 supplementary runtime declaration tasks, not 25 extra buildings. When mapped, preserve AUX IDs as alias/mapping records, not duplicate render targets.
Historical aliases 奉天门/皇极门 for 太和门 do not merge it with the separate 宁寿宫皇极门. Code x<0 is east, x>0 west.
Raw Layout roof fields are not active truth for 太和门/保和殿/中和殿; REAL/SquareHalls overrides are decisive. palace/gate.js is not imported by current entry chain.
